item.title: Implement atomic thread-safe ledger
item.brief:
Implement ledger.py per SPEC.md, preserving its documented API and every specified error/boundary case. Add focused standard-library tests beyond the existing basics, including validation/copy isolation, account errors, overflow, same-account behavior, and deterministic thread safety/linearizability where practical. Run the test suite and commit the work. Use only the Python standard library.

## Amendment (2026-11-20 11:58 UTC)

Concurrency and locking are explicit requirements; proceed on adaptive and implement/test/commit the complete requested change.

## Amendment (2026-11-20 11:58 UTC)

This item continues with the stages of pipeline `adaptive` after its run failed at stage `implement`: ESCALATE: re-queue on adaptive. The requested implementation requires thread-safe linearizability and locking (atomic source/destination checks and writes, consistent snapshots, and no deadlock for opposite transfers). The attempt instructions explicitly require committing nothing and escalating when the task turns out to involve concurrency or locking. Read SPEC.md, ledger.py, test_ledger.py; baseline commit is fda844caf627a7d6cf975451191d6eb19a87ecf3, with a clean worktree and ledger.py still containing NotImplementedError stubs. No files changed and no checks run.
The work that run committed is on branch `archon/s7148zvf-implement-atomic-thread-safe-ledger` in this worktree. Continue from it; do not start over.

pr.body: Implemented constructor validation and defensive copies, serialized transfer checks and updates plus snapshots under a per-ledger lock, and normalized unhashable account lookups to the documented KeyError. Added standard-library coverage for validation, copy isolation, account errors, overflow, same-account transfers, opposite-direction progress, and consistent snapshots. `python -m unittest -v` passed (10 tests); `git diff --check` passed. Assumption: dict subclasses are accepted as dict inputs; values and account names must be exact built-in int and str. Review coverage: whole change base fda844caf627a7d6cf975451191d6eb19a87ecf3 to 0ec27122d8a1526cd687e3a9b8e1e099710abd2b, followed by fix delta 0ec27122d8a1526cd687e3a9b8e1e099710abd2b to 632820801137568830bb5c286eec52da6798427b. The initial blocking account lookup finding was fixed and verified; no follow-ups remain.
pr.summary: Implemented the bounded, thread-safe ledger. Before: ledger methods were unimplemented. Now: transfers and snapshots are atomic, with validation and documented failure behavior covered by tests.
